about: Give each Commuter Agent's Habitual Travel Patterns (manuscript Sec. 4.3.3).
rules: Give each agent's recurring travel: frequent_locations (location_id from the agent's activity_locations, with the activity done there) and recurring_trips.
activity: work at workplace, school, market, mall, terminal; school at school; shopping at market, mall; leisure at mall; out_of_area at terminal. At home: home.

A recurring trip: trip_key (unique per agent, e.g. R1), origin and destination (the agent's home_id or a frequent location), purpose (the activity at the destination, home for the agent's home), days (of Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun), usual_departure (HH:MM) and mode_preference_weights.
mode_preference_weights: one weight from 0 to 1 per mode in the agent's usable_modes, adding up to 1.
On each day the trips, in order of departure, must start at home, go on from where the one before ended, and end at home.
At least one recurring trip, unless the agent has no activity_locations. reachable_by lists the modes that can make the trip there and back (the vehicle comes home).
